cases.title: DevOps Lead, Bagira
cases.jdText:
Bagira is a leader in the field of training and simulation systems with a track record of delivering high\-end, customized, cost\-effective solutions for mission readiness. Bagira’s simulators are being used by hundreds of thousands of soldiers at more than 40 sites worldwide.
   

  

 Bagira is looking for a
 **DevOps Lead** 
 to join our engineering team at Bagira.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced technical leader with strong leadership qualities, a can\-do attitude, and a passion for building secure, scalable cloud architectures. In this role, you will own the cloud architecture vision and execution, work closely with development teams to enable high\-velocity delivery, and lead the DevOps team through mentoring, best practices, and hands\-on technical leadership.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Lead the end\-to\-end cloud architecture, design and implementation, with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability.
* Own and evolve the DevOps roadmap, tooling, and operating model across R\&D.
* Partner with software architects and developers to design deployment patterns, service architecture, and production\-grade infrastructure.
* Lead, mentor, and grow the DevOps team, set technical standards, conduct design reviews, and drive professional development.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and automation to improve quality and delivery speed.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management, ensuring environments are reproducible and auditable.
* Establish cloud security best practices, including IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, secure baselines, and continuous compliance.
* Design observability practices (monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing), define SLOs/SLAs, and improve incident response readiness.
* Optimize cloud cost and performance, including capacity planning, scaling strategies, and continuous efficiency improvements.
* Take part in hands\-on execution when needed, especially in early\-stage architecture and key infrastructure components.


 Requirements:
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure roles, including at least 2 years leading a team or technical leadership of a DevOps function.
* Strong experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including networking, compute, storage, and managed services.
* Proven experience building secure and scalable architectures, including IAM, security controls, encryption, secrets management, and secure networking patterns.
* Strong hands\-on experience with CI/CD (for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and modern release practices.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) and automation scripting (Python, Bash, or similar).
* Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm), including production operations and scaling.
* Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, Splunk, or similar) and incident management processes.
* Solid understanding of Linux, networking fundamentals, and troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Excellent communication skills, ability to collaborate across teams, and a practical leadership approach.
cases.why: Platform scope fits, but requires 2+ years leading a team; role is mostly managerial.

cases.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, Radware
cases.jdText:
About the job
Radware is a global leader of cyber security and application delivery solutions for physical, cloud, and software defined data centers.

At Radware, we live and breathe cybersecurity. It is our passion. Each day, our international team works to earn the trust of more than 12,500 organizations around the globe. Keeping them safe is our mission. To that end, we go head-to-head with politically motivated hacktivists, dangerous nation-state threat actors and other notorious cyber attackers — these are not your average adversaries. Backed by nearly 30 years of experience, Radware is best known for its technical excellence and innovative network and application security solutions. That is why it is so important that we build our team with bold and bright talent.

About the Team:

We are looking for a talented Senior DevOps to join its Cloud R&D Team. Radware’s Cloud-based security services combine Big Data analytics, machine learning technologies, and behavioral analysis for cyber threat detection, assessment, and mitigation.

As a Senior DevOps in our team, you will have the opportunity to lead and work with cutting-edge cloud technologies and best-in-class DevOps practices.

What is the job:

Be in charge of complex, distributed, high-scale production cloud systems
Develop and maintain a modern state-of-the-art CI/CD pipeline to improve R&D processes
Take responsibility and implement automated build and deployment processes
Manage and create automated configurations for our Cloud environments
Integrate test automation into the CI/CD cycle
Take part in building cloud-based big data solution
Build cloud-based monitoring and alerting capabilities
Maintain overall industry knowledge of the latest trends, technology, etc.
Act as the coach and mentor to team members and technical staff
What you need:

Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or similar
Experience as a DevOps lead in cloud-based environments (Minimum of 5 years)
Experience in building CI/CD processes and pipelines (Jenkins, k8s, etc.)
Experience with Linux and networking
Experience with monitoring, maintaining, and optimizing production systems
Strong Shell/Bash/Python scripting skills and experience
Proven hands-on experience with Containers (Docker) and Orchestration tools (Kubernetes).
Experience with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform
Strong working knowledge of AWS and Azure
Experience with version control systems (Git, Bitbucket)
Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and tools
Ability to clearly articulate design and implementation choices
Team player and excellent interpersonal skills
Primary Location

IL-IL-Tel Aviv

Work Locations

Radware Israel, Tel Aviv
cases.why: Strong stack and culture fit at a product company in Tel Aviv. The role itself is IC work plus mentoring. One requirement line reads 'Experience as a DevOps lead' but no people-management duties appear anywhere in the role description — likely loose Israeli phrasing for 'senior'. Worth caution, not rejection.

cases.title: Platform Engineer, Pango
cases.jdText:
We’re looking for Platform Engineer to join our Engineering Platform team and help build, automate, and maintain the infrastructure that supports our products and engineering teams.
 



 This is an excellent opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies, learn from experienced engineers, and contribute to the tools and platforms used across the company.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Help maintain and improve Pango’s AWS environment while supporting scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure.
* Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain Terraform modules, reusable infrastructure, and automation.
* CI/CD \& Developer Experience: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and support developer productivity.
* Monitoring \& Reliability: Help monitor production systems, improve observability, and contribute to operational excellence.
* Collaboration: Work closely with software engineers, participate in code reviews, and continuously learn new technologies.



  





 Requirements:
 


* 3\+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud, SRE, or Platform Engineering.
* Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, and CI/CD concepts.

cases.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, Earnix
cases.jdText:
About the job
As a Senior DevOps Engineer on the Price-It Platform team, you’ll own core cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and the Kubernetes platform that powers Earnix’s cloud-based decisioning products for global insurers and banks. You’ll take end-to-end technical ownership of high-impact platform initiatives — from design through production — working hands-on across AWS, Kubernetes, and automation, while shaping how the team builds and ships.

What You'll Do:

Own and evolve the cloud platform: AWS infrastructure, EKS/Kubernetes, and Terraform-based Infrastructure-as-Code.

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows that keep delivery fast, safe, and repeatable.

Design and operate secure networking and access (ALB, OIDC/OAuth2, JWT/M2M, Okta, firewalling).

Drive reliability, scalability, and resilience — including disaster recovery and multi-region readiness.

Partner closely with R&D, Product, QA, and Support to take initiatives from design to production.

Improve developer experience and velocity, including through AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows.

Mentor and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design reviews, and documentation.

Requirements:

You’ll Do It Using:

5+ years of hands-on DevOps / Platform Engineering experience.

Production expertise with AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), and Terraform (Infrastructure-as-Code).

Strong CI/CD (Jenkins or equivalent), GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm, and containerization (Docker).

Solid cloud networking, security, and IAM fundamentals.

Scripting in Python and/or Bash.

Familiarity with AI-assisted / agentic development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude).

Advantages: Observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog), Karpenter, Crossplane, Kyverno, DR/multi-region, FinOps; relevant academic background or equivalent practical experience.

You’ll Excel By:

Working effectively in a fast-paced, growing, and global environment.

Bringing a creative, structured, and proactive approach to problem solving.

Communicating clearly and professionally with different audiences.

Being well-organized, independent, collaborative, and accountable.

Position Intro:

Earnix is the premier provider of mission-critical, cloud-based intelligent decisioning across pricing, rating, underwriting, and product personalization. These fully-integrated solutions provide ultra-fast ROI and are designed to transform how global insurers and banks are run by unlocking value across all facets of the business. Earnix has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001 with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel.
cases.why: Platform team, DevEx and agentic workflows fit. Held back by stacked production-expertise gaps: AWS, EKS, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, Python.

cases.title: Software Dev Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure, Yahoo
cases.jdText:
About the job
Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever.

It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of nearly 900 million. Whether you're automating the infrastructure behind our massive ad tech stacks, building the platforms that power our cloud-native services, or designing the systems that help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will greatly impact our business—and the world. Want in?

A Little About Us:

Yahoo Mail is the second largest Email provider in the world with a very large number of active users, and thus very high throughput and scale. Digital Transformation is a highly critical multi-year initiative for Yahoo Mail, as part of which, we are modernizing our current tech stack on a public cloud while building new cloud-native components, systems, and tools to support a wide range of core features and functionality. As a result, we need highly qualified engineers to design, automate, and operate scalable Mail Infrastructure on the public cloud for a large number of Mail services and components.

A Lot About You:

You are a self-starter with a commitment to building, automating, and operating infrastructure and platforms on the public cloud at scale. You think in terms of automation, reliability, and repeatability, and you're happiest when you've eliminated manual toil through code. You maintain an adaptive, AI-forward mindset, continuously looking for ways to leverage modern developer tools to increase team velocity. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment, with the ability to adapt to new technologies and learnings, and to prioritize multiple tasks and challenges in order to keep pace with an innovative and changing product and technical landscape. Your strong technical background, automation mindset, and clear communication skills will serve you well in this role, as will your comfort working with our high-energy team.

Your Day:

Design, build, and operate large-scale cloud infrastructure, platforms, and services, using Kubernetes-based orchestration solutions.
Use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — such as Terraform — to automate the provisioning and management of infrastructure and services.
Build CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling to streamline deployments and improve reliability.
Write automation and tooling primarily in Python, utilizing approved AI-assisted programming tools (such as Amazon Q Developer or Gemini Code Assist) to accelerate code generation, syntax optimization, and test coverage.
Conduct thorough peer reviews of cloud configurations, infrastructure policies, and code—ensuring the verification, security, and quality of both human-authored and AI-assisted outputs.
Work seamlessly in both individual and team settings on innovative infrastructure technologies.
Participate in a culture of learning through design discussions and technical reviews.

You Must Have:

BS/M.S. in Computer Science preferred along with 3+ years of experience.
Solid hands-on experience with public cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS/Azure).
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar) and Kubernetes.
Proficiency in Python for automation and tooling.
Experience building CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated familiarity with or interest in utilizing generative AI developer tools (e.g., AI pair-programmers, code completion assistants) to streamline daily coding workflows and reduce time-to-delivery.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Structured thinker, excellent communication, and interpersonal skills.

Nice to Have:

Familiarity with observability tooling (Cloud Monitoring, Datadog, etc.).
Working knowledge of Java (for collaborating with development teams).

Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. Yahoo will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. Yahoo is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment. If you need accessibility assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability, please submit a request via the Accommodation Request Form (www.yahooinc.com/careers/contact-us.html) or call +1.866.772.3182. Requests and calls received for non-disability related issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

Yahoo has a high degree of flexibility around employee location and hybrid working. In fact, our flexible-hybrid approach to work is one of the things our employees rave about. Most roles don’t require specific regular patterns of in-person office attendance. If you join Yahoo, you may be asked to attend (or travel to attend) on-site work sessions, team-building, or other in-person events. When these occur, you’ll be given notice to make arrangements.

If you’re curious about how this factors into this role, please discuss with the recruiter.

Currently work for Yahoo? Please apply on our internal career site.
cases.why: Large-scale cloud platform work, K8s and CI/CD, AI-forward culture with peer reviews. 3+ years, no leadership requirement.

cases.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Platform, Lemonade
cases.jdText:
Lemonade
Description:
About the job
What You’re Applying For

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Platform team in Tel Aviv. You'll build the infrastructure that powers our entire engineering organization, accelerating how our teams ship features that millions of customers rely on. This role is perfect for someone who loves solving complex distributed systems challenges and creating tools that make other developers' lives better.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In This Role You'll

Build core platform services that support all Lemonade development teams across web, mobile, and backend systems
Design and maintain robust APIs for distributed microservices architecture using TypeScript, with Rust experience as a major plus
Collaborate with staff engineers and tech leads to establish platform standards, patterns, and best practices across the engineering organization
Own service stability and communication between systems, implementing both synchronous and asynchronous patterns at scale
Drive developer efficiency initiatives by creating tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that eliminate friction for product teams
Work hands-on with AWS infrastructure including Kafka, RabbitMQ, EKS, SQS, Lambda, and infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi
Partner closely with DevOps teams to ensure seamless deployment, monitoring, and scaling of platform services

What you'll need:

5+ years as a software engineer with strong focus on backend systems and platform development
Deep experience with distributed systems and microservices, including building and maintaining APIs that serve multiple teams
Hands-on expertise with modern infrastructure — AWS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, EKS, SQS, Lambda, Helm, Terraform, or Pulumi
TypeScript proficiency with Rust experience strongly preferred
Platform or core team background — you've built infrastructure that supports multiple development teams, not just end-user features
Developer empathy — you understand what makes engineers productive and can translate that into platform solutions
Ready to work in an office environment most days a week

Things to know…

Lemonade is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity. We never discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. If you require reasonable accommodations due to religious beliefs, pregnancy, or disabilities, let us know at any time.
cases.why: Platform team at an established public company; TypeScript and RabbitMQ fit, explicit DevEx. Caveats: Rust strongly preferred, mostly on-site.

cases.title: Automation Developer, Finubit

cases.title: Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer, ERGO NEXT
cases.jdText:
ERGO NEXT
Description:
About the job
Location: Kfar Saba, IL (hybrid)

ERGO NEXT's mission is to help entrepreneurs thrive. We’re doing that by building the only technology-led, full-stack provider of small business insurance in the industry, taking on the entire value chain and transforming the customer experience. Simply put, wherever you find small businesses, you’ll find ERGO NEXT.

Since 2016, we’ve helped hundreds of thousands of small business customers across the United States get fast, customized and affordable coverage. We’re backed by industry leaders in insurance and tech, and we still have room to grow — that’s where you come in.

At NEXT, a cloud-native company, our platform is the heartbeat of our operation. We are looking for a Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer who is passionate about building scalable, resilient, and developer-friendly infrastructure. You won't just be "managing servers"; you will be architecting the internal platform that enables our entire engineering organization to ship code faster and more reliably.

You will be a part of a small, ultra-talented, and supportive Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer. This is a unique opportunity to learn from seasoned experts and contribute directly to high-impact projects from day one.In this role, you will be a key driver of our infrastructure evolution. You will design and implement robust systems primarily using AWS, leveraging EKS to run and deploy our services, and treating 100% of our environment as code using Terraform. We are looking for someone who doesn't just follow industry trends but thinks "out of the box" to solve complex architectural challenges, ensuring our infrastructure serves as a seamless "product" for our internal developers.

As our team also acts as the centralized FinOps authority, your ability to understand the cost implications of architectural decisions is a significant plus, helping us maintain a high-performance yet cost-efficient cloud environment.

What You’ll Do

Infrastructure Design & Automation: Architect and maintain our core cloud infrastructure, focusing on building a robust foundation that supports self-service capabilities for engineering teams to manage their own resources within a governed framework.
Innovate & AI Integration: Constantly evaluate new technologies to improve our stack. In the AI era, you will help manage the infrastructure supporting our AI initiatives and look for ways to integrate AI into our internal tooling.
GitOps & Deployment: Utilize technologies like ArgoCD to manage and deploy.
Infrastructure Integrity & Custom Tooling: We are uncompromising about our "100% Infrastructure as Code" standard—if it’s not in Git, it doesn't exist. You will take ownership of this vision by developing bespoke, in-house automation and monitoring tools to eliminate manual changes, ensuring the AWS console remains strictly read-only and our cloud state is always perfectly synced with our code.
Kubernetes Excellence: Optimize and scale our EKS clusters, ensuring they are robust enough to host both our backend/frontend services and our internal tooling.
Governance & Landing Zone: Manage our multi-account AWS strategy using Control Tower and automated Account Factories, ensuring isolation, security, and environment consistency (Dev/Stg/Prod/DR).
Efficiency Mindset: Act as a key member of the team driving cloud cost awareness and accountability across the organization, helping to optimize resources and foster a data-driven FinOps culture.
Observability & Monitoring: Implement and maintain comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions (Mimir, Grafana ect’) to ensure the health, performance, and reliability of our platform and services. Drive a culture of data-driven incident response and proactive system optimization.

What We Need

Technical Core: Minimum of 3 years of experience in DevOps or Platform Engineering, with proven experience in Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Knowledge of Terraform is an advantage.
Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with AWS (which is preferred) or any other major cloud provider like Azure and GCP. A solid understanding of multi-account strategies and core services is key.
Containerization: Basic knowledge of Kubernetes. Experience with EKS is an advantage.
Infrastructure as Code: At least 1 year of experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with proficiency in Terraform. You believe that if it's not in Git, it doesn't exist.
Mindset: You are a natural problem-solver who thinks creatively and is a fast learner. You are comfortable working in a "read-only console" environment where automation is the default.
Communication: Ability to explain complex infrastructure concepts to stakeholders and mentor fellow engineers

Nice To Have

AI Infrastructure: Experience implementing AI into DevOps tools or managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads.
Multi-Cloud: Familiarity with Azure or GCP (where we maintain smaller footprints).
FinOps: Experience or interest in cloud cost optimization and accountability.
cases.why: Explicit IDP - self-service for engineering teams, infrastructure as an internal product. 100% IaC, GitOps, in-house tooling. AWS/Terraform listed as advantages, Azure accepted, 3+ years, no leadership requirement.

cases.title: DevOps Engineer, Kaltura
cases.jdText:
Kaltura’s (NYSE:KLTR) mission is to power any video experience for any organization – live, on-demand, or real-time. We not only want to make using video simpler, but we also want to better people’s lives through video. Founded in 2006, Kaltura is now a global leader in the video market with millions of people using our products daily to teach, learn, watch, connect, and collaborate. Among our customers, you’ll find more than 1000 global, well-known organizations.

15+ years since starting the company, we continue to foster a diverse and collaborative work environment where everyone gets a say. Our team is currently 700+ people, and we’re still growing. We have offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, but our technology is all in the cloud.

Kaltura has a fast-paced environment where initiative is always encouraged. Together with our hybrid work model and flexible state of mind, you get the right conditions for creative juices to flow freely. Thanks to our long line of products, cultivation of rich collaborative culture and care for each Kalturian, you’ll never run out of room to grow and evolve.

If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below - that's okay, nobody's perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this is a role that would make you excited about coming to work every day.

Requirements:

The role

You will join a global DevOps & Platform team responsible for designing and operating distributed production systems at very high scale, with a relentless focus on quality, robustness, and reliability. We provide Kaltura with the tools it needs to push forward product innovation and scale in the age of AI.

You will own projects end-to-end, drive new implementations forward, and act as a technical partner across the organization. You'll work closely with the Platform teams, Development teams, Architects, AI/ML Researchers, and Product, translating complex needs into resilient systems that scale.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, who can see a problem or a need, shape the solution, and carry it all the way to production.

﻿The day-to-day

Lead initiatives end-to-end, from design through implementation to production rollout, owning the outcome, not just the task
Design, build, and operate highly available, distributed systems at scale on AWS and GCP, with a strong emphasis on quality and robustness
Work across the full platform stack, Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm, CI/CD and automation, and the data, caching, and messaging layers (Mongo, MySQL, Postgres, Redis, Kafka, and more)
Modernize and consolidate different stacks and architectures into Kaltura's single, coherent platform
Build and operate the infrastructure behind our AI workloads, including GPU inference and the platforms that serve them
Drive system reliability, monitoring, and observability, and troubleshoot complex issues across application, infrastructure, networking, OS, and data layers
Collaborate across Platform, Development, Architects, AI/ML Researchers, and Product, and leverage modern AI coding tools to work at high velocity and quality

Ideally, we’re looking for:

2+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps / Platform / SRE roles, operating distributed production systems at high scale, with a proven ability to lead projects independently and drive new implementations end-to-end
Deep hands-on expertise with AWS in production (EKS, ECS, S3, EC2, CloudFront, IAM, Bedrock, MSK, Lambda, Cloudwatch) including Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and Helm, including a strong understanding of how Kubernetes internals work and how to operate them in production, alongside Docker / containerized systems
Strong knowledge of networking and operating systems (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, Linux internals)
Strong experience with CI/CD and automation (GitHub Actions), monitoring and observability (metrics, tracing, logging, tools like Prometheus / Grafana)
High proficiency with current AI coding tools, including a deep understanding of how they work and how to apply them to drive real productivity.

These would also be nice:

Experience integrating or migrating systems between different stacks or organizations
Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives
Experience working with GPUs for inference and serving AI/ML workloads

 The perks: 

Hybrid, flexible work environment 
Extended private health (including mental) insurance 
Personal and professional development programs 
Occasional Cross company long weekends
cases.why: Platform team, GitHub Actions and MongoDB fit, strong AI-tooling emphasis, no leadership requirement. Held back by stacked deep-expertise demands: AWS (9 named services), Kubernetes internals, Terraform, networking, GCP.

cases.why: Closest stack match so far - Azure, AKS, Azure DevOps, K8s. Held back by the employer being an R&D outsourcing and placement firm, not the product company; anonymous JD ('a fast-growing enterprise technology company') with no team or culture detail.

cases.title: Senior Backend Engineer (DevOps-Oriented), Conntour
cases.jdText:
About the job
About Conntour

Conntour is a defense-tech startup backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, including YC, General Catalyst, and SV Angel.

We are building the next generation of defense-tech autonomous systems, connecting distributed camera networks, AI models, and natural-language interfaces to surface mission-critical insights in real time.

Our platform is already protecting sensitive sites for private and government agencies, and we’re just getting started.



The Impact You’ll Make

As a Senior Backend Engineer at Conntour, you’ll be one of the first engineers shaping the foundation of our platform.

You’ll design and build high-scale, performance-critical backend systems that power real-time video and AI-driven workflows in high-stakes environments. Your work will directly influence our architecture, infrastructure, deployment strategy, and engineering standards from the ground up.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves building robust systems, optimizing performance, owning infrastructure, and solving hard problems where reliability and speed matter.



What You’ll Do

Design, build, and own high-performance backend services for real-time, mission-critical systems.
Develop scalable data pipelines for camera networks, video streams, AI/ML outputs, and operational insights.
Build systems optimized for low latency, high throughput, reliability, and resilience.
Own backend architecture decisions across APIs, databases, infrastructure, observability, and deployment.
